---- MODULE GermanControlBenchmarks ----
EXTENDS GermanControlBenchmarksDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL AgtPf == INSTANCE TLAPS

AgtTypeOK ==
    /\ cache  \in [NODE -> {"I", "S", "E"}]
    /\ chan1  \in [NODE -> {"Empty", "ReqS", "ReqE"}]
    /\ chan2  \in [NODE -> {"Empty", "Inv", "GntS", "GntE"}]
    /\ chan3  \in [NODE -> {"Empty", "InvAck"}]
    /\ invSet \subseteq NODE
    /\ shrSet \subseteq NODE
    /\ exGntd \in BOOLEAN
    /\ curCmd \in {"Empty", "ReqS", "ReqE"}
    /\ curPtr \in NODE \cup {NoNode}

\* Every node holding a copy is registered as a sharer.
AgtInvA == \A i \in NODE : cache[i] # "I" => i \in shrSet
\* Exclusive copies exist only while exclusive access is granted.
AgtInvB == exGntd = FALSE => \A i \in NODE : cache[i] # "E"
\* While exclusive access is granted there is at most one sharer.
AgtInvC == exGntd = TRUE => \A i, j \in NODE : (i \in shrSet /\ j \in shrSet) => i = j
\* A grant in flight is accounted for in the sharer set.
AgtInvD == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i] \in {"GntS", "GntE"} => i \in shrSet
\* A node that has acknowledged an invalidation holds no copy, ...
AgtInvE == \A i \in NODE : chan3[i] = "InvAck" => cache[i] = "I"
\* ... has an empty inbound channel, ...
AgtInvF == \A i \in NODE : chan3[i] = "InvAck" => chan2[i] = "Empty"
\* ... and is still registered as a sharer.
AgtInvH == \A i \in NODE : chan3[i] = "InvAck" => i \in shrSet
\* An invalidation in flight also belongs to a registered sharer.
AgtInvG == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i] = "Inv" => i \in shrSet
\* Invalidations already sent are no longer pending in invSet.
AgtInvJ == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i] = "Inv" => i \notin invSet
AgtInvK == \A i \in NODE : chan3[i] = "InvAck" => i \notin invSet
AgtInvL == invSet \subseteq shrSet
\* Invalidation traffic occurs only when exclusive access must be revoked
\* or the pending request is an exclusive one, ...
AgtInvM == \A i \in NODE : (chan2[i] = "Inv" \/ chan3[i] = "InvAck")
                              => (curCmd = "ReqE" \/ exGntd = TRUE)
\* ... and only while a request is being served.
AgtInvN == \A i \in NODE : (chan2[i] = "Inv" \/ chan3[i] = "InvAck") => curCmd # "Empty"
\* An exclusive grant in flight implies exclusive access is granted.
AgtInvP == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i] = "GntE" => exGntd = TRUE

AgtInv ==
    /\ AgtTypeOK
    /\ AgtInvA /\ AgtInvB /\ AgtInvC /\ AgtInvD /\ AgtInvE
    /\ AgtInvF /\ AgtInvG /\ AgtInvH /\ AgtInvJ /\ AgtInvK
    /\ AgtInvL /\ AgtInvM /\ AgtInvN /\ AgtInvP

LEMMA AgtInitInv == Init => AgtInv
  BY AgtPf!SMTT("r30")
  DEF Init, AgtInv, AgtTypeOK, AgtInvA, AgtInvB, AgtInvC, AgtInvD, AgtInvE,
      AgtInvF, AgtInvG, AgtInvH, AgtInvJ, AgtInvK, AgtInvL, AgtInvM, AgtInvN,
      AgtInvP

LEMMA AgtInvCoherence == AgtInv => Coherence
  BY AgtPf!SMTT("r30")
  DEF AgtInv, AgtTypeOK, AgtInvA, AgtInvB, AgtInvC, Coherence

LEMMA AgtNextInv == AgtInv /\ [Next]_vars => AgtInv'
  <1> SUFFICES ASSUME AgtInv, [Next]_vars
               PROVE  AgtInv'
    OBVIOUS
  <1>1. CASE UNCHANGED vars
    BY <1>1, AgtPf!SMTT("r30")
    DEF vars, AgtInv, AgtTypeOK, AgtInvA, AgtInvB, AgtInvC, AgtInvD, AgtInvE,
        AgtInvF, AgtInvG, AgtInvH, AgtInvJ, AgtInvK, AgtInvL, AgtInvM, AgtInvN,
        AgtInvP
  <1>2. CASE Next
    <2>1. PICK i \in NODE :
                \/ SendReq(i)
                \/ RecvReq(i)
                \/ SendInv(i) \/ SendInvAck(i) \/ RecvInvAck(i)
                \/ SendGnt(i)
                \/ RecvGnt(i)
      BY <1>2 DEF Next
    <2>2. CASE SendReq(i)
      BY <2>2, AgtPf!SMTT("r30")
      DEF SendReq, AgtInv, AgtTypeOK, AgtInvA, AgtInvB, AgtInvC, AgtInvD,
          AgtInvE, AgtInvF, AgtInvG, AgtInvH, AgtInvJ, AgtInvK, AgtInvL,
          AgtInvM, AgtInvN, AgtInvP
    <2>3. CASE RecvReq(i)
      BY <2>3, AgtPf!SMTT("r30")
      DEF RecvReq, AgtInv, AgtTypeOK, AgtInvA, AgtInvB, AgtInvC, AgtInvD,
          AgtInvE, AgtInvF, AgtInvG, AgtInvH, AgtInvJ, AgtInvK, AgtInvL,
          AgtInvM, AgtInvN, AgtInvP
    <2>4. CASE SendInv(i)
      BY <2>4, AgtPf!SMTT("r30")
      DEF SendInv, AgtInv, AgtTypeOK, AgtInvA, AgtInvB, AgtInvC, AgtInvD,
          AgtInvE, AgtInvF, AgtInvG, AgtInvH, AgtInvJ, AgtInvK, AgtInvL,
          AgtInvM, AgtInvN, AgtInvP
    <2>5. CASE SendInvAck(i)
      BY <2>5, AgtPf!SMTT("r30")
      DEF SendInvAck, AgtInv, AgtTypeOK, AgtInvA, AgtInvB, AgtInvC, AgtInvD,
          AgtInvE, AgtInvF, AgtInvG, AgtInvH, AgtInvJ, AgtInvK, AgtInvL,
          AgtInvM, AgtInvN, AgtInvP
    <2>6. CASE RecvInvAck(i)
      BY <2>6, AgtPf!SMTT("r30")
      DEF RecvInvAck, AgtInv, AgtTypeOK, AgtInvA, AgtInvB, AgtInvC, AgtInvD,
          AgtInvE, AgtInvF, AgtInvG, AgtInvH, AgtInvJ, AgtInvK, AgtInvL,
          AgtInvM, AgtInvN, AgtInvP
    <2>7. CASE SendGnt(i)
      BY <2>7, AgtPf!SMTT("r30")
      DEF SendGnt, AgtInv, AgtTypeOK, AgtInvA, AgtInvB, AgtInvC, AgtInvD,
          AgtInvE, AgtInvF, AgtInvG, AgtInvH, AgtInvJ, AgtInvK, AgtInvL,
          AgtInvM, AgtInvN, AgtInvP
    <2>8. CASE RecvGnt(i)
      BY <2>8, AgtPf!SMTT("r30")
      DEF RecvGnt, AgtInv, AgtTypeOK, AgtInvA, AgtInvB, AgtInvC, AgtInvD,
          AgtInvE, AgtInvF, AgtInvG, AgtInvH, AgtInvJ, AgtInvK, AgtInvL,
          AgtInvM, AgtInvN, AgtInvP
    <2>9. QED
      BY <2>1, <2>2, <2>3, <2>4, <2>5, <2>6, <2>7, <2>8
  <1>3. QED
    BY <1>1, <1>2
\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM Spec => []Coherence
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_GermanProtocol/GermanControlBenchmarks_Coherence.tla
  BY AgtInitInv, AgtNextInv, AgtInvCoherence, AgtPf!PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_GermanProtocol/GermanControlBenchmarks_Coherence.tla
====
